description: Metrics storage, logging, and event tracking for tunnel operations

requirements.title: Metrics time-series storage
requirements.description: Store scraped cloudflared metrics (HA connections, error rate, RTT, active streams) in SQLite with timestamps. Retain 7 days of 1-minute resolution data.

requirements.title: Probe history storage
requirements.description: Store probe results per route in SQLite: timestamp, route, internal result, external result, classification, response time. Retain 7 days.

requirements.title: Structured logging
requirements.description: All operations logged with structured fields: component, action, result, duration, error. Log to stderr in JSON format for journalctl compatibility.

requirements.title: Health API endpoint
requirements.description: GET /health returns composite tunnel health for other Vrooli scenarios (e.g., vrooli-autoheal) to consume. Includes route-level status summary.
